title: fix(plugin-auth): SSO-user doors admit the stamped organizationId when it is the session's, so console Import Users and Add User work
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBXim82sEGBUBXqH4hkWyBJX)_

Fixes #34912

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzi3ezPzTysQPDEjmVz

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:三个 SSO 用户入口(`admin/import-sso-users`、`admin/add-sso-user`、`admin/remove-sso-user`)现在接受请求体里的 `organizationId`,但只在它等于调用者会话当前组织时接受;不等、类型不对、或会话没有当前组织都会被 400 拒绝,且什么都不写。
- **为什么改**:控制台的「导入用户」「添加用户」经服务端动作转发到 `/api/v1/auth/`,转发统一附带调用者的 `organizationId`,而这三个入口拒收任何未知键,所以托管环境里每个管理员点这两个按钮都必然 400。
- **风险与回滚**:组织范围仍只取自会话,请求体里的值只做相等校验、从不参与范围;风险面是「请求体能否改写组织」,已有拒绝用例与消融钉住。回滚即还原 `pending-sso-users.ts` 一个文件。
- **先看**:`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/pending-sso-users.ts` 的 `refuseForeignOrganization`(三个入口共用的校验);同文件三处 `unknownBodyKeys` 调用;`pending-sso-users.test.ts` 末尾的 `[#34912]` 用例组。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/pending-sso-users.test.ts -t 34912`,预期 14 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `pending-sso-users.ts`: one shared check, `refuseForeignOrganization`, runs in all three doors right after their closed-key check. `organizationId` is the only key admitted beyond each door's own set (`unknownBodyKeys`), and only as a statement the session already makes:
  - absent: unchanged;
  - equal to `deps.getCallerActiveOrganizationId()` (the caller's own session, read with the request's headers through `authApi.getSession`; the route wiring already passes it to these doors, so no wiring change): admitted, then never read again. Scope stays the session's: single-org binds the sole organization as before, multi-org joins the session organization in `settleRequest` as before;
  - a different string: `400 INVALID_REQUEST`, the sentence names the organization sent and the one the session holds;
  - not a non-empty string (`null`, `''`, a number): `400 INVALID_REQUEST`;
  - any value while the session works in no organization: `400 NO_ACTIVE_ORGANIZATION`.
  Every refusal happens before any read, write or host call. Both codes are already in the error-code ledger; no new code.
- The generic identity-route stamp in `buildApiActionRequest` (`packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts`) is unchanged (seat ruling A).
- Changeset: `@objectstack/plugin-auth` patch, with both declaration lines.

## Tests

- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/pending-sso-users.test.ts`, new top-level describe in the shared harness (real `AuthManager` and real route mount, real bearer sessions):
  - for each of add, import and remove: absent key accepted; equal key accepted (membership in the session organization); a different organization refused 400 naming both, with nothing written and no host told; no active organization in the session plus a body organization refused 400 `NO_ACTIVE_ORGANIZATION` (and, on add, a CONTROL: the same request without the key still answers 201);
  - add: `null`, `''` and `42` refused 400;
  - over fakes with multi-org tenancy on: a foreign body organization is refused and the join never runs; an equal one is admitted and the join is handed the session's value.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/api-action-forward.test.ts` (the `buildApiActionRequest` harness), CONTROL describe: the declared `sys_user.import_sso_users` and `add_sso_user` actions are still stamped with the caller organization, `ban_user` (another identity route) keeps the stamp, and a caller with no organization gets no stamp.
- Ablation of the equality check (`if (sent !== current) {` to `if (false) {`, via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor 1 to 0, blob `ed0b3c405d81` to `2cd498db4bb9`): exactly the four foreign-organization legs go red (add, import, remove, multi-org fake), 10 others stay green; restored, blob back to `ed0b3c405d81` = HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- `admin/remove-sso-user` has no declared console action: no `sys_user` action targets it, although the auth route ledger note says Setup → Users posts it. Its live reading posts the body an identity-route forward would send. Noted, not filed.
- The Import Finished result dialog draws its fields and per-row table past the dialog's right edge (screenshot `after-2-import-result.png` in the live readings). Reported to the seat as a separate UX finding; not touched here.
- `content/docs/permissions/authentication.mdx` and the auth route ledger describe these bodies without `organizationId`; they are outside this card's file surface and were left as they are.
